{{EventEnded|date = 8th of May 2021|event = [[Halloween 2020 Event]]}} {{for|the [[Citizen 1]]|[[Citizen Plush]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = Citizen2.png |image-dynamic = Citizen2Dynamic.png |image-dynamic-start = 0 |source = [[Trick or Threat Town]] Wave 18 |type = Humanoid |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |spawnrate = Variable |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:OffensiveModifier.png|20px|Damage]]35 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.33 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |speed = 5 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Citizen 2''' was a unique [[units|unit]] not spawned by a specific [[tower]]. It appeared during [[Trick or Threat Town]] on wave 18 to support your towers. It did not stop to attack an enemy when it detected one in its range, meaning that it inevitably ran into the enemy. It was a melee unit, so it had short range. However, it dealt high damage and had a relatively low firerate. ==Appearance== The '''Citizen 2''' had tan skin. It had a beige shirt, brown legs and black shoes. It wore a dusty farmer cap. It wielded a sword to attack enemies. ==Strategy== *The '''Citizen 2''' spawns interchangeably with the [[Citizen 1]]. **When wave 18 starts, five random citizens (either [[Citizen 1|1]] or '''2''') spawn. After that, every 12-17 seconds, another random citizen will spawn. *Do not rely solely on the '''Citizen 2''' for damage. They should only be used as a desperate last resort when [[Lord Sinister]] approaches the end of the map. **As the '''Citizen 2''' has short range and does not stop to attack enemies, it is unlikely that it will damage an enemy with its sword. **The '''Citizen 2''' is most useful against weaker enemies summoned by [[Lord Sinister]], like the [[Hallow Bones]]. Treat them as passive damage rather than a main attacking source. *If [[Lord Sinister]] uses its ''Infernal Storm'' attack, and a '''Citizen 2''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. *The '''Citizen 2''' cannot detect [[Flying]] or [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. It also cannot collide with the [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]] as it is a ghost enemy. ==Trivia== *The '''Citizen 2''' was one of the two [[units]] without an associated tower or consumable, alongside the [[Citizen 1]]. **This unit was more offensive-based than [[Citizen 1]], as it had faster speed and higher DPS in comparison. However, it had shorter range and lower health. *Unlike other humanoid [[units]], the '''Citizen 2''' did not stop to attack enemies. It instead moved while attacking enemies, similar to the [[Military Base]]'s [[units]]. *The sword used by the '''Citizen 2''' is the {{RLinkC|125013769|Linked Sword}} gear from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Citizen 2''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Citizen 2''' removed. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Trick or Threat Town]]
